adelaide_csm: Quick alert — BridgeCare's renewal in 18 days. Signals: billing contact changed, scheduled-report success rate <60%, and they haven't run the updated onboarding checklist. Looking to define a 10-day mini-save play.

ravi_ops: Ops notes: they run daily heavy-report jobs during the 02:00 UTC window. If we reduce plan we can switch them to nightly rollups instead of real-time workers; retention of exports can be kept 45d.

mike_support: There's a pattern of missed webhook deliveries to their analytics endpoint last week; delivered events show 502s. Filed case SUP-2367 and requested logs from their infra team.

adelaide_csm: Proposed mini-save: 1) 20m health sync (today/tomorrow), 2) enable nightly rollups + walkthrough, 3) 2-week "report stamina" credit if they run 5 scheduled reports and trigger 1 alert. If they opt-out, present downgrade with preserved exports.

zoe_onboarding: I can run the walkthrough and a quick checklist: must-complete steps: connect report sinks, generate one scheduled report, and confirm alert delivery. I'll include a 3-question feedback at end.

notif-bot: Reminder scheduled: 'BridgeCare health sync' assigned to zoe_onboarding at 2026-03-27T13:00:00Z.

mike_support: Update on SUP-2367: root cause likely transient upstream proxy overload. Suggested temporary mitigation: exponential backoff + queueing on client. Reached out.

ravi_ops: Downgrade pack: - nightly-rollup mode enabled, - S3 export bucket preserved for 45d, - read-only API token for exports. If they need archival beyond 45d, offer opt-in cold storage.

adelaide_csm: Owners: zoe -> run walkthrough and capture feedback, ravi -> prepare downgrade pack and confirm exports, mike -> chase SUP-2367 with priority. I'll draft the customer note: short + empathetic.

zoe_onboarding: Scheduled the 20m walkthrough for tomorrow. Will send meeting notes and checklist result here.

adelaide_csm: Thanks team. Keep replies short in-thread. If anything urgent, ping me directly. :handshake:
